scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @civic263/web && npm run build --workspace @civic263/ops && npm run build --workspace @civic263/functions
scripts.test: node --experimental-strip-types --test packages/domain/src/domain.test.ts packages/domain/src/report-resolution.test.ts packages/domain/src/community.test.ts packages/domain/src/review-reminders.test.ts scripts/read-saved-drafts.test.ts scripts/mobile-motion.test.ts scripts/service-colors.test.ts functions/src/report-intake.test.ts functions/src/place-lookup.test.ts functions/src/automatic-review.test.ts scripts/native-attestation.test.ts packages/domain/src/field-test.test.ts
scripts.verify: npm run check:scaffold && npm run test && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run build && npm run check:mobile
scripts.emulators: npm run build --workspace @civic263/functions && npx --yes firebase-tools@15.35.0 emulators:start --project demo-civic263
scripts.format: prettier --write apps packages functions docs scripts *.json *.md *.mjs .github/workflows/*.yml
